name: Product Experience
description: Turns a request into a complete, useful and coherent user experience.
guidance: Translate the objective into a clear information hierarchy and an intentional user journey.
Write specific, credible interface copy; never use Welcome, Lorem ipsum, TODO or generic filler.
Provide a clear value proposition, meaningful content, trust cues and calls to action appropriate to the request.
Keep the experience focused: progressive disclosure, clear labels and no technical clutter for end users.
completion_checks: The result solves the stated user goal and contains all requested sections.
Content hierarchy, navigation and calls to action are understandable without explanation.
No placeholder, unfinished section or decorative-only control remains.
